name_vi: Module ghế sofa góc độc lập
description_en: A square corner sofa module with two perpendicular woven back panels and one cushion; the front shows the open diagonal entry, the side reveals one full back panel and the detachable joining sockets, and the rear shows the L-shaped corner post and cross-braced base. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A square corner sofa module with two perpendicular woven back panels and one cushion; the front shows the open diagonal entry, the side reveals one full back panel and the detachable joining sockets, and the rear shows the L-shaped corner post and cross-braced base. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. CRITICAL CAMERA CORRECTION: Angle correction is critical: canonical front camera faces the DIAGONAL OPEN CORNER entry of this square L-back corner chair. Orbit EXACTLY 90 degrees around its vertical center to the chair's RIGHT from that diagonal entry viewpoint, keeping horizontal camera at seat mid-height. This right-profile direction must show one OUTSIDE woven back panel near the viewer and the other back panel at an angle; it must not show a full flat inside back panel with a broad unobstructed seat as if only 45 degrees rotated. Preserve the same four posts, lattice panels, white cushion and red frame.
